title: RLC 串联谐振
statement: RLC 串联电路：R = 10 Ω，L = 0.1 H，C = 10 µF，电源 U̇_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），电源角频率等于电路的谐振角频率 ω₀。
求谐振频率 f₀、谐振时的电流 I、电容电压与电源电压之比 U_C/U_s（即品质因数 Q），并回答关于谐振时电压的概念题。

questions.ask: 谐振时电流有效值 I = ?
questions.explain: 谐振时 X_L = X_C，Z = R（最小、纯电阻），I = U_s/R = 10/10 = 1 A，与电源电压同相。

questions.ask: 谐振时，L 与 C 串联部分两端的总电压是多少（即相量和 U̇_L + U̇_C 的有效值 |U̇_L + U̇_C|）？
choices: 0（U̇_L 与 U̇_C 大小相等、相位相反）
choiceExplain: 把有效值直接相加了：U̇_L 与 U̇_C 相位相差 180°，要按相量相加。
10 V 是 U_R，谐振时电源电压全部加在 R 上；L、C 串联部分的电压是另一回事。
141.4 V = √(100² + 100²)，是把 U̇_L 和 U̇_C 当成了相互垂直；它们一个超前电流 90°、一个滞后 90°，是反相的。
questions.explain: U̇_L = jQU_s = j100 V，U̇_C = −jQU_s = −j100 V，相加为 0：LC 串联部分相当于短路，电源电压全部加在 R 上。所以串联谐振又叫电压谐振。

hints: 谐振时 Z = R；Q = ω₀L/R，U_L = U_C = Q·U_s。
solution: **2. 谐振电流。** X_L = ω₀L = 100 Ω = X_C，Z = R = 10 Ω，I = 10/10 = **1 A**，与 U_s 同相（电路呈纯电阻性，电流达到最大）。
**4. 相位。** U̇_L = j100 V 超前电流 90°，U̇_C = −j100 V 滞后电流 90°，两者之和为 0；U_R = 10 V = U_s。
高 Q 的串联谐振电路中，L、C 上会出现远高于电源电压的“过电压”，实际中要注意元件耐压。

en.title: Series RLC resonance
statement: A series RLC circuit has R = 10 Ω, L = 0.1 H, C = 10 µF and is driven by U̇_s = 10∠0° V (rms) at the circuit's resonant angular frequency ω₀.

Find the resonant frequency f₀, the current I at resonance, the ratio of the capacitor voltage to the source voltage U_C/U_s (the quality factor Q), and answer the concept question on the voltages at resonance.

questions.explain: At resonance X_L = X_C, so Z = R (minimum and purely resistive): I = U_s/R = 10/10 = 1 A, in phase with the source voltage.
U_C = I·X_C = 1 × 100 = 100 V, ten times the source voltage: Q = ω₀L/R = 1/(ω₀CR) = 100/10 = 10.

questions.ask: At resonance, what is the total voltage across the series L–C part (the rms value of the phasor sum, |U̇_L + U̇_C|)?
choices: 0 (U̇_L and U̇_C are equal in size and opposite in phase)
200 V (both are 100 V, so they add)
choiceExplain: This adds rms values: U̇_L and U̇_C are 180° apart and must be added as phasors.
10 V is U_R — at resonance the whole source voltage appears across R; the voltage across the L–C pair is a different quantity.
141.4 V = √(100² + 100²) treats U̇_L and U̇_C as perpendicular; one leads the current by 90° and the other lags by 90°, so they are in antiphase.
questions.explain: U̇_L = jQU_s = j100 V and U̇_C = −jQU_s = −j100 V add to 0: the series L–C part acts as a short and the whole source voltage appears across R. That is why series resonance is also called voltage resonance.

hints: Series resonance condition: ωL = 1/(ωC), i.e. ω₀ = 1/√(LC).
At resonance Z = R; Q = ω₀L/R and U_L = U_C = Q·U_s.
solution: **2. Current at resonance.** X_L = ω₀L = 100 Ω = X_C, Z = R = 10 Ω, I = 10/10 = **1 A**, in phase with U_s (the circuit is purely resistive and the current is at its maximum).
**3. Quality factor.** Q = ω₀L/R = 100/10 = **10**; U_C = I·X_C = 100 V = Q·U_s, and U_L is also 100 V.
**4. Phases.** U̇_L = j100 V leads the current by 90°, U̇_C = −j100 V lags it by 90°; they sum to 0, and U_R = 10 V = U_s.
In a high-Q series resonant circuit L and C see voltages far above the source voltage, so their voltage ratings matter in practice.
